tools.name: pdf_repair
tools.description: Scan damaged PDF binary objects and reconstruct broken/truncated XRef tables and trailers via pdf-lib.

tools.name: pdf_compliance_audit
tools.description: Audit a PDF for hidden 3-Tr invisible text operators, OCG layers, active /JS, annotations, and metadata leaks, and optionally issue a SHA-256 Compliance Certificate PDF.

tools.name: pdf_merge
tools.description: Merge multiple base64-encoded PDF documents cleanly in exact page order via pdf-lib.

tools.name: pdf_split
tools.description: Split a PDF by page range or page chunk size into an extracted PDF slice plus per-range metadata.

tools.name: pdf_remove_pages
tools.description: Delete specified 1-based page numbers or ranges from a PDF document.

tools.name: pdf_extract_pages
tools.description: Extract and reorder specific 1-based pages from a PDF into a new PDF file.

tools.name: pdf_rotate
tools.description: Permanently rotate all or selected pages of a PDF by 90, 180, or 270 degrees clockwise.

tools.name: pdf_add_page_numbers
tools.description: Stamp vector pagination or Bates numbers (e.g. "Page X of Y") onto every PDF page.

tools.name: pdf_add_watermark
tools.description: Overlay a diagonal translucent vector text watermark (e.g. CONFIDENTIAL) across all pages of a PDF.

tools.name: pdf_crop_margins
tools.description: Trim uniform PDF CropBox margins (in points) across all pages while preserving vector content.

tools.name: pdf_protect_metadata
tools.description: Audit PDF encryption state, scrub identifying Creator/Producer/Author metadata, and stamp deterministic integrity protection headers.

tools.name: pdf_unlock_strip_restrictions
tools.description: Load owner-restricted PDFs (ignoreEncryption) and re-serialize clean unlocked pages without permission locks.

tools.name: pdf_redact_terms
tools.description: Scan PDF text streams for target terms or PII patterns (emails, SSNs, cards) and purge matching raw stream literals + metadata before re-saving.

tools.name: pdf_forms_inspect_and_fill
tools.description: Inspect all interactive AcroForm fields in a PDF, optionally fill text/checkbox fields from JSON, and flatten form widgets.

tools.name: pdf_to_markdown
tools.description: Extract uncompressed PDF text operators (Tj/TJ) and document metadata into clean Markdown.

tools.name: pdf_to_pdfa_archival
tools.description: Normalize a PDF for long-term ISO-19005 PDF/A-like archival consistency by flattening forms, embedding standard fonts, and setting XMP/catalog timestamps.

tools.name: pdf_compare
tools.description: Structurally compare two PDFs (page count, page dimensions, metadata, SHA-256, and extracted text tokens) to pinpoint differences.

tools.name: pdf_compress
tools.description: Compact a PDF structurally by stripping unused objects, clearing XMP/metadata bloat, and enabling PDF 1.5 compressed Object Streams.

tools.name: pdf_from_images
tools.description: Wrap one or more JPEG/PNG images (or fall back to an annotated vector page) into a clean PDF document.

tools.name: pdf_from_html_text
tools.description: Render HTML or plain text into a paginated vector PDF document using pdf-lib.
